candidates.title: BUILD FOR HER 💕💻A WOMEN’S SOCIAL IMPACT HACKATHON #SFTechWeek
candidates.evidence:
BUILD FOR HER 💕💻A WOMEN’S SOCIAL IMPACT HACKATHON #SFTechWeek
Renaissance Entrepreneurship Center
San Francisco, CA
FREE COMMUNITY EVENT
Okay builders, this one is for you 🩵

On October 10th, we’re bringing 30–40 women together in San Francisco during SF Tech Week for Build For Her - a Women’s Social Impact Hackathon.

We’re building around:

🩺 Women’s Health
💸 Economic Mobility
🛡️ Women’s Safety

And! We were just notified that Build For Her was selected for Tech Week’s Hack Week builder track 😆

We’re looking for women across engineering, AI/data, product, design, research, healthcare, fintech, safety/security, policy + social impact.

You do NOT have to be an engineer or have hackathon experience. Good teams need people who understand the problem just as much as the technology.

Alsooo…some of our longtime Glow Girls already know about this but we’ve been quietly building something called RoamHer. You’ll hear a lot more about her soon, but Build For Her is one of the first experiences we’re bringing to life under RoamHer🩵

Oct 10 | San Francisco | 9AM–5PM

Meet other builders + find your team in the Discord:
https://discord.gg/FWy7whDpR

Presented by RoamHer.
